variants.specifics: Brackenford: Three townsfolk: a tease, a worry about Corwin, a jab at the player.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: You're mighty scrawny for a bandit-chaser. Hah, hah, hah...!

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: I hope Corwin stays up on his hill.

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Well you sure don't look like much. I'm glad you aren't the one guarding our gate.

variants.specifics: Krennack: Three townsfolk: Old Gant with a pointer, Mirri worrying about the Ogres, Dolla in a fright.

rumour1.speaker: Gant
rumour1.text: Foreman Brakkus is over at the Pit Office. He keeps the keys to every shaft in Krennack.

rumour2.speaker: Mirri
rumour2.text: How can a town of miners fight off Ogres? This is a disaster! What will become of us?

rumour3.speaker: Dolla
rumour3.text: Oh No! An Ogre! Hide the gold!

variants.specifics: Skell: Three villagers: Corra, Grume and Tibbet.

rumour1.speaker: Corra
rumour1.text: I thought adventurers never got lost. Try following the lanterns.

rumour2.speaker: Grume
rumour2.text: Is that Necromancer really as ugly as folks say?

rumour3.speaker: Tibbet
rumour3.text: I do all right selling frog legs.

variants.specifics: Varrok: A soldier of the garrison, Lissa, and Pellam, who has lost his cart.

rumour1.speaker: Soldier
rumour1.text: Find that Grukk and knock his ugly head clean off!

rumour2.speaker: Lissa
rumour2.text: You've only just come to Varrok, haven't you? Pity you're not one of the garrison. I just adore soldiers!

rumour3.speaker: Pellam
rumour3.text: Did you see where my cart went? It couldn't have just rolled off by itself!

variants.specifics: Kesk: Three folk of Kesk: Fennic, Agna and Yarnoth.

rumour1.speaker: Fennic
rumour1.text: There is a weapon smith next to Selka's inn.

rumour2.speaker: Agna
rumour2.text: So you're the one who cleared out those slimy Leeches! Bless you, stranger!

rumour3.speaker: Yarnoth
rumour3.text: We must take up our oars and send those dead things back to the bottom of the lake!

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Three townsfolk: Dilly gossips about Malgrin, Orlo the student taunts, Gasper the senior student boasts.

rumour1.speaker: Dilly
rumour1.text: There is a wicked old wizard -- Malgrin -- hiding out in the Gloomfen. They say the College threw him out for turning his teacher into a goat!

rumour2.speaker: Orlo
rumour2.text: Can't answer? Not so clever, eh?

rumour3.speaker: Gasper
rumour3.text: We have mastered the Fireball! Now we must burn every last Ogre out of the Gloomfen!

variants.specifics: Ulmgard: Three townsfolk of Ulmgard: Fennick stuck to a railing, Pell in a hurry, Brannoc worried about the Undead.

rumour1.speaker: Fennick
rumour1.text: Help! Help! My tongue's stuck to the railing!

rumour2.speaker: Pell
rumour2.text: I'm due up on the wall at noon, sorry.

rumour3.speaker: Brannoc
rumour3.text: Beware! Those Undead grow bolder every night!

variants.specifics: Kalgarr: Brix worries about Malgrith, Dorla shouts a warning, Grizzel cackles at the player.

rumour1.speaker: Brix
rumour1.text: Malgrith must have learned the forbidden secrets of fire. One morning the Deep Furnace was quiet and by supper it was boiling over with Ember Demons and Imps! They want our forges.

rumour3.speaker: Grizzel
rumour3.text: Hurry, hero, hurry! Hee, hee, hee...!

variants.specifics: Torvel: Tobb points to the inn, old Wilk sends adventurers off, Dorla worries about Skarn at Varga Tower.

rumour1.speaker: Tobb
rumour1.text: Welcome to Torvel. The Crooked Crown is the big house on your left.

rumour2.speaker: Wilk
rumour2.text: Adventurer! Hmph! I know what your lot do to an honest man's chickens! Shoo!

rumour3.speaker: Dorla
rumour3.text: We'll keep our shutters barred here, but somebody has to face Skarn at Varga Tower. May your luck hold on that cursed hill, stranger!

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5)

variants.specifics: Durnhal: Posey brushes the player off, Mott the drunkard taunts, Bessa saw an Ogre in the Mayor's pig trough.

rumour1.speaker: Posey
rumour1.text: Mother says I'm not supposed to speak to outsiders.

rumour2.speaker: Mott
rumour2.text: Are you gonna run off? Little lamb's scared of a few Ogres?

rumour3.speaker: Bessa
rumour3.text: Eww! I saw a big hairy Ogre sit right down in Mayor Quillon's pig trough!
